title: NextLeap Product Management Course with Placement Support
content:
Course: Product Management Course (Fellowship)
Fee: ₹39,999 (Full Course Fee). EMI starting at ₹1322/month. Early bird discounts available.
Duration: 16 weeks
Instructors/Mentors: Arindam Mukherjee (Co-founder, ex-Flipkart), Karthi Subbaraman (ServiceNow, ex-Microsoft), Prashanth Bhaskaran (Uber), Eshan Tiwari (Meta), Kartik Singh (Microsoft), Devansh (Jiostar), Saksham Arora (Intuit), Shailesh Sharma (Myntra).

Curriculum:
- Weeks 1-3: Product Core & Problem Solving
- Week 11: Interview Prep (Guesstimates & RCAs)
- Week 12: Product Design & Metrics
- Week 13: Strategy & AI Product Sense
- Week 14-16: Graduation Project
Tools: Figma, JIRA, Whimsical, Microsoft Clarity, SQL, OpenAI, Claude, Cursor.
